East shows a hunched profile: the dome sits high over a low body, a narrow beaked head with a dark eye juts forward, two long thin clawed forelimbs reach ahead and down, and two thick hind legs carry pale haunches. North shows the dome from behind, pale rounded haunches, thick dark rear legs and the thin forelimbs just visible between them. No face.
observed.south.png: Front view at full resolution: a beaked head centred under the crust lip, facing the camera; a pale soft belly; two slender picking arms with long curved claws reaching toward the ground; four outer legs with dark scaly skin. The crust has glossy grey highlights on its facets and molten-orange seams. The background is transparent.
observed.east.png: Side profile: the domed crust is offset toward the rear and overhangs a low pale body. The head is small and beaked with a hooked tip. The forelimbs are long, thin and jointed, with hooked claws held forward near the ground. The hind legs are heavy and dark. The cream-coloured underside shows clearly below the crust edge. The background is transparent.
observed.north.png: Rear view: the full crust dome with glowing cracks, two pale rounded haunches below it, two heavy dark rear legs, and the tips of the forelimbs visible between them. No head, no eyes, no tail. The background is transparent.
observed.scale.png: Beside the vanilla human at max zoom the creature is about knee-to-hip height and roughly one cell wide, a small animal. At 32 px per cell it reads as a dark lump with pale legs next to the pawn, smaller than the human.
